name: Chat Tools
description: Extras for Owncast chat: a live list of who is in chat, inline image previews, a GIF picker and image uploads.

inlineImages.description: Preview image and GIF links that people paste into chat from other sites. GIFs from the search and uploaded images are always shown, whatever this is set to.

gifSearch.description: Show the GIF search button in the chat box. Also needs a GIPHY API key below.

allowUploads.description: Show the image upload button in the chat box, so people in chat can upload an image or GIF from their device.

requireName.description: Ask viewers who still have an auto-generated name to pick their own before they can type in chat. Watching the stream and reading chat are never blocked.

giphyApiKey.description: GIPHY API key for GIF search. The key is sent to viewers' browsers, as GIPHY requires searches to come from the browser.

giphyRating.description: Maximum GIPHY content rating for search results: g, pg, pg-13 or r.

uploadsPerHour.description: How many uploads each person may make per hour.

uploadRetentionDays.description: Days to keep uploaded images before they are removed. Set to 0 to keep them forever.

imageHosts.description: Optional comma-separated list of hosts allowed for inline previews (e.g. i.imgur.com, media.giphy.com). Leave empty to allow any https image link.
